patch.description: EPIC-17: G04 — Professional flats and CAD interchange. Admission: docs/planning/EPIC-17-ADMISSION.md. DGS S667 AutoCAD/Design lost units, geometry, identities and layers; S668 approved /2 ASTM/AAMA Pattern import returned blank/0; S669 invalid native control exported metadata text only and exact self-import rendered blank/0. DGS remains retired except one first-party-instructions-bounded native validity check in S670; no standards claim. Continue existing CLO evidence and preserve all-seven/options/grades, 0.001 cm, all V03 gates, final output review, PR, safe merge, ancestry and deployment.
